  "assessment": "## Change Extent & Scope
The task requires fixing a pagination routine that silently discards trailing rows, causing an audit mismatch. The diff modifies exactly `expo/paging.py`, targeting the `pages()` function responsible for chunking exports. This aligns precisely with the stated scope.

## What this change does
It appends the remaining partial page whenever the total row count is not an exact multiple of `PAGE_SIZE`. The new conditional preserves those trailing items before returning.

## Change Extent & Scope
The task requires fixing a pagination routine that silently discards trailing rows, causing an audit mismatch. The diff modifies exactly `expo/paging.py`, targeting the `pages()` function responsible for chunking exports. This aligns precisely with the stated scope.

## What this change does
It appends the remaining partial page whenever the total row count is not an exact multiple of `PAGE_SIZE`. Previously, integer division combined with a fixed loop range stripped any leftover rows after the final full page, directly causing the 7-missing audit failure. The new conditional preserves those trailing items before returning.

## Findings
None. The change resolves the described truncation bug without altering file paths, constants, or line shapes. Host measurements confirm structural validity, zero vetoes, and all five acceptance tests passing. No additional defects are present.
